title: Bacon Cheddar Patty Cakes
description: Leftover mashed potatoes join forces with Cheddar cheese and crumbled bacon to make a main dish out of yesterday's side dish.

steps.text: Place the bacon in a large, deep skillet, and cook over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned and crisp, about 10 minutes. Remove the bacon slices, crumble, and set aside. Leave the bacon drippings in the skillet.
Mix the mashed potatoes, eggs, onion powder, salt, and black pepper together in a bowl; stir in the crumbled bacon and Cheddar cheese.
Form the mixture into 8 patties. Heat the bacon drippings over medium heat, and pan-fry the patties in the drippings until crisp on each side, about 4 minutes per side.

video.description: As if mashed potatoes weren’t tempting enough, now they get jazzed up with flavors of onion, salt and pepper and fried into crispy-cheesy decadence! First begin by frying up some bacon, then crumble and add it to creamy mashed potatoes with eggs, onion powder, salt and pepper. Seal the deal with shredded Cheddar cheese and form into patties. Then deep fry until golden and serve with sour cream and chopped green onion for a truly delicious brunch or indulgent lunch!
